ZAINAB KE AANSUON ME
english translation text: WHAT CAN SUGRA SEE IN ZAINAB’S TEARS\nSCENES OF KARBALA ARE EVIDENT IN ZAINAB’S TEARS

arabic text:
BARCHI KA ZAKHM TAZA
TA ZINDAGI RAHEGA
AKBAR KA HAI KALEJA
ZAINAB KE AANSUON ME
english translation text: AKBAR’S HEART IS EMBLAZONED IN ZAINAB’S TEARS\nTHE WOUND OF AKBAR’S CHEST WILL REMAIN FRESH FOREVER
